title: Opus 5.5 Cut Prices 20%, Costs 40%
caption:
Anthropic cut Opus prices 20% and called it 40%.

Both are true. List went $5/$25 → $4/$20 per million; the rest of the saving is the model burning fewer tokens and generating output 30%+ faster, which only ever shows up on your bill and never on the pricing page. The one I actually care about is cache reads — $0.50 to $0.20. I run agent loops that re-read the same context every turn, so that line is most of my spend.

Admission: I've stayed on Sonnet for cost reasons all year. I don't think that math holds anymore.

What's your default model?

slides.title: $4 In, $20 Out
slides.sub: Down from $5 and $25 on Opus 5. Same 1M context.

slides.headline:
Cache Reads
Fell 60%
slides.sub: $0.50 to $0.20 per million — the biggest single cut, and the one an agent loop pays every turn.

slides.headline:
The Rest Is
Fewer Tokens
slides.sub: Anthropic’s 40% figure isn’t the price cut. Output generates 30%+ faster and the model spends fewer tokens per task.

slides.headline:
Pro Now Starts
On Opus
slides.sub: Claude Code 2.1.280 changed the default on Pro and Team Standard from Sonnet to Opus. Five-hour limits went up too.
